phases.name: Pure core and async fetch loop

steps.name: Retry policy decision
criteria: A failed request is retried at most three attempts in total, with growing backoff between attempts
A Retry-After hint from the server is honoured in preference to computed backoff
A 403 whose reason is a rate limit is decided exactly as a 429; other 4xx statuses are never retried
Exhausted 5xx retries resolve to the gmail.server-error refusal
steps.implementation_notes: Pure function, no node: imports. Switch scenario( to it( in this file, implement decideRetry, remove __SCAFFOLD__. Unit tests are fast-check properties (project stack is Vitest + fast-check, not Hypothesis). Contract shape: pure-function. Full suite must stay green.

steps.name: Endpoint resolution with loopback-only override
criteria: By default Gmail, token and consent endpoints resolve to Google's hosts under /gmail/v1, /token and /o/oauth2/v2/auth
HARVEST_API_BASE_URL redirects all endpoints only when it names a loopback host; the override wins over the client file's token_uri
Any non-loopback or disguised host is refused with gmail.base-url-not-loopback
steps.scenario_name: all scenarios in endpoints.test.mjs (12; @sizing-review-needed, 8+ scenarios, parametrised host table)
steps.implementation_notes: Pure, no node: imports (parse hosts with the WHATWG URL global). Implement resolveEndpoints, remove __SCAFFOLD__. Refusal names and env var are pinned by the test and need a DR-0011 note (DISTILL pre-requisites). Property tests where the contract is quantified; the parametrised table is the fallback.

steps.name: OAuth pure helpers
criteria: PKCE S256 challenge matches the RFC 7636 vector and an independent oracle
The consent URL carries the read-only scope, state and challenge; a callback with a mismatched state, denial or missing code is refused with its named auth.* refusal
Token responses without a refresh token, with a wrong scope, or with an endpoint error are refused by name; invalid_grant yields gmail.reauth-required
Expiry is judged with a skew margin
Credential-file shape and the 0600 file / 0700 directory rule are decided from stat facts passed in
steps.implementation_notes: Pure; hashing/randomness are injected or use Web Crypto globals only, no node: imports. Refusal-code enums are already real values in the scaffold. Remove __SCAFFOLD__. Sizing: crafter may commit in slices (PKCE/URL, callback parse, token parse, file rules) so long as the file ends fully on. Property tests for round-trips and refusals.

steps.name: Gmail message to cache record, and descriptor sender
criteria: A format=full Gmail resource becomes the cache record shape that slim accepts, walking the parts tree for the plaintext body
A resource with no plaintext body is refused with missing-plaintext-body
The sender is normalised to its bare address
The LinkedIn source descriptor exposes its sender as data, and its matcher agrees with it
Listing date is checked against the query window bounds
steps.implementation_notes: Pure. Expose SENDER as a descriptor field and derive matches from it; existing linkedin tests must stay green. Remove __SCAFFOLD__ from gmail-message.mjs. Parity here proves only the round trip through the composed fixture shape; DESIGN flag 6 is closed in 03-03.

steps.name: Settled-day clamp
criteria: A requested range is clamped so its last day is no later than yesterday in UTC
A range with no settled day yields an explicit nothing-settled result
Clamping is idempotent and correct at the UTC midnight boundary
steps.implementation_notes: Implement clampToSettledDays beside nextUncoveredDay, reusing its day arithmetic; time is passed in, never read. Remove the module-level __SCAFFOLD__ from coverage.mjs. Existing coverage tests unchanged.

steps.name: Async fetch loop and UNKNOWN_SOURCE refusal
criteria: The loop awaits list, read and probe so a network source can drive it
A day is committed to the ledger only when every listed message is cached and the count check passes; otherwise the run refuses and commits nothing for that day
A listing failure part way, or a readiness failure, refuses with its named refusal and leaves earlier committed days intact
Re-running after a partial run resumes without duplicating cache writes
An unknown source id refuses with FetchRefusal.UNKNOWN_SOURCE
The existing synchronous-source fetch-loop scenarios still pass once their two throw assertions become rejects
steps.scenario_name: all scenarios in fetch-loop-async.test.mjs (9; @sizing-review-needed, 8+ scenarios) plus tests/acceptance/job-alert-harvester/fetch-loop.test.mjs kept green
steps.implementation_notes: Mechanical async change; logic unchanged (OQ-1). The ONLY permitted edit to an existing test is the human-approved change of the two toThrowError assertions in fetch-loop.test.mjs to rejects.toThrowError; nothing else weakened. Add UNKNOWN_SOURCE to FetchRefusal and make support/gmail-domain-types.mjs re-export it in place of UNKNOWN_SOURCE_REFUSAL. Callers of runFetchLoop (harvest.mjs) are adapted in 03-02; if any current caller breaks the suite, adapt it minimally here. Universe: cache + ledger via assertStateDelta.

steps.name: Credential store
criteria: Client and token files are read only when regular files with mode 0600 inside a 0700 directory; wider modes are refused by name
A symlink or non-regular credential path is refused with gmail.credential-invalid
Token writes are atomic via a sibling tmp file and leave the mode at 0600
The client file is never written by any operation
steps.implementation_notes: Real filesystem under temp HOME. Delegate permission decisions to core/oauth.mjs; the adapter only gathers stat facts and performs I/O. Bounded-change universe: ~/.config/job-alert-harvester/{client,token}.json plus sibling tmp. Exports probe(). Remove __SCAFFOLD__.

steps.name: Google token source
criteria: An access token is refreshed once per process and reused until its skewed expiry
A rotated refresh token is persisted through the injected store; the access token is never written to disk
The code exchange is never retried
invalid_grant, endpoint errors and scope mismatches surface their named refusals with no secret in the message
steps.implementation_notes: Receives store, fetch, now and endpoints as arguments; imports no other adapter. Bounded-read except one POST to the token endpoint. Exports probe(). Remove __SCAFFOLD__.

steps.name: OAuth loopback listener
criteria: The listener binds 127.0.0.1 only and serves one static page
It accepts a single callback then closes; a second request is not served
An unanswered consent ends in auth.consent-timeout
The port is released on every return path
steps.implementation_notes: Only place a socket is opened. Real socket in test. Callback parsing and state check stay in core/oauth.mjs. Timeout is injected for test speed. Remove __SCAFFOLD__.

steps.name: Gmail API source: list, read, probe
criteria: list queries exactly one UTC day for the descriptor sender, follows pagination and de-duplicates ids
A malformed envelope, an incomplete listing, a lying resultSizeEstimate, an out-of-window message or an id mismatch each refuse with a named refusal
Retryable failures follow the retry policy and exhaust to a named refusal; a 401 triggers one token refresh
The adapter can only issue GET requests

probe refuses every condition in the DESIGN table (missing/invalid/wide-mode credentials, revoked token, scope, wrong mailbox, rejected query, quota, sender-matches-nothing), leaves credentials byte-identical and puts no secret in any refusal
steps.scenario_name: all scenarios in gmail-source-list-read.test.mjs (21) and gmail-source-probe.test.mjs (24) (45 total; @sizing-review-needed, crafter may commit list/read then probe)
steps.implementation_notes: Receives a GET-only capability, token provider, now and sleep; imports no other adapter. Decisions (retry, message translation, window check) come from core. A page failing after the first refuses gmail.list-incomplete. probe is unbounded-preservation: no writes, no message reads. Remove __SCAFFOLD__. Two test files by design: one module, one step.

steps.name: auth orchestration
criteria: harvest auth records the consent-granted refresh token and mailbox address as a 0600 token file
The PKCE verifier is proved on the wire at the token exchange
A recovery run after revocation replaces the token
Each auth.* refusal (state-mismatch, consent-denied, no-code, no-refresh-token, exchange-failed, consent-timeout) writes nothing to disk
The consent URL is printed and no token is ever printed
steps.implementation_notes: runAuth takes fetch, store and listener as arguments and builds no adapter; harvest.mjs does wiring (DISTILL upstream issue 4). Remove __SCAFFOLD__.

steps.name: harvest fetch and auth subcommands (walking skeleton)
criteria: An operator runs harvest fetch --source linkedin over two settled days and finds the alerts in the cache with coverage committed, as the walking skeleton
Unknown source, nothing settled, range clamped to yesterday, idempotent re-run and resume behave as specified with exit 1 and a named refusal on failure
Wide-mode credentials, a revoked token, a sender matching nothing, an empty envelope and a non-loopback override each refuse before any cache write
harvest auth completes consent, and a revoke, re-auth, fetch chain succeeds
plan-fetch, ingest and build behave unchanged
steps.scenario_name: all scenarios in fetch-cli.test.mjs (14, includes the @walking_skeleton and 2 @driving_adapter; @sizing-review-needed, 8+ scenarios)
steps.implementation_notes: Composition root: async main; wire store, token source, gmail source and loop for fetch, and store, listener and runAuth for auth; wire then probe then use. Leave the ingest block untouched. Subprocess test against loopback fake, real temp HOME. Note the run needs HARVEST_API_BASE_URL loopback override. Existing suite must stay green.

steps.name: Close-out: probe-presence test, scaffold sweep, parity procedure
criteria: A test fails if any of the seven state, credential or network adapters lacks an exported probe
No __SCAFFOLD__ marker remains anywhere in src/
A documented one-off procedure or script compares a real users.messages.get format=full response against the cached record for DESIGN flag 6, needs the operator's credential, and is not run in CI
The full suite passes with RED_GATE unset and with RED_GATE=1
steps.scenario_name: new probe-presence test (not in the 193 DISTILL scenarios); zero-scaffold check is a repo grep
steps.implementation_notes: The one permitted new test is the presence check (scope per corrected DESIGN layer 1: adapters owning state, a credential or a network boundary: ledger-store, message-cache, raw-spill-source as applicable, plus the four new adapters). It must fail if a probe is removed. The parity script does I/O so lives outside src/core; crafter may instead record a documented procedure in the feature delta. Record DR-0011 note for the pinned names if not yet ratified.
